name: route_intent
description: Classify launcher input text to pick the next action suggestion. Call this for EVERY input; never stay silent. translate: input is natural-language text (a full sentence or phrase, NOT a URL/path/identifier) written in a language foreign to the user's UI language Chinese, OR an explicit translation request (翻译/fanyi/translate). ask_ai: input is Chinese natural-language text addressed to the assistant (question, request, instruction). open_url: input is a web URL. open_path: input is a file system path (Windows like C:\dir\file.ext, UNC \\server\share, or unix /usr/bin/...). none: app names, search keywords, code identifiers, shell commands, emails, UUIDs, color codes, IPs - anything typed to search and launch.
